quotes.quote: Aut inveniam viam aut faciam
quotes.author: Hannibal Barca

quotes.quote: If you wish to be out front, then act as if you were behind.
quotes.author: Lao Tzu

quotes.quote: A disciplined mind leads to happiness, and an undisciplined mind leads to suffering.
quotes.author: Dalai Lama

quotes.quote: The only discipline that lasts is self-discipline.
quotes.author: Bum Philips

quotes.quote: You have power over your mind, not outside events. Realize this, and you will find strength.
quotes.author: Marcus Aurelius

quotes.quote: Success doesn't just happen. You have to be intentional about it, and that takes discipline.
quotes.author: John C. Maxwell

quotes.quote: The first and greatest victory is to conquer self.
quotes.author: Plato

quotes.quote: I do not talk about my weaknesses. I work on them.
quotes.author: Fedor Emelianenko

quotes.quote: Give what you have. To someone, it may be better than you dare to think.
quotes.author: Henry Wadsworth Longfellow

quotes.quote: Don't ask your leader what you should do, tell them what you are going to do.
quotes.author: Jocko Willink

quotes.quote: Instead of letting the situation dictate our decisions, we must dictate the situation.
quotes.author: Jocko Willink

quotes.quote: The more you practice, the better you get, the more freedom you have to create.
quotes.author: Jocko Willink

quotes.quote: If you get your ego in your way, you will only look to other people and circumstances to blame.
quotes.author: Jocko Willink

quotes.quote: Leaders must own everything in their world. There is no one else to blame.
quotes.author: Jocko Willink

quotes.quote: Leadership requires belief in the mission and unyielding perseverance to achieve victory.
quotes.author: Jocko Willink

quotes.quote: You know what the best thing is about the end of the day? Tomorrow, it starts all over again.
quotes.author: Douglas Coupland

quotes.quote: Good leaders don't make excuses. Instead, they figure out a way to get things done.
quotes.author: Jocko Willink

quotes.quote: The only person you can control is you. So focus on making yourself who you want to be: Faster. Smarter. Stronger. More humble. Less ego.
quotes.author: Jocko Willink

quotes.quote: Plans are worthless, but planning is everything.
quotes.author: Dwight D. Eisenhower

quotes.quote: If you know the enemy and know yourself, you need not fear the result of a hundred battles.
quotes.author: Sun Tzu

quotes.quote: The price of inaction is far greater than the cost of making a mistake.
quotes.author: Meister Eckhart

quotes.quote: Discipline equals freedom.
quotes.author: Jocko Willink

quotes.quote: We do not rise to the level of our expectations. We fall to the level of our training.
quotes.author: Archilochus

quotes.quote: The soldier is the Army. No army is better than its soldiers.
quotes.author: George S. Patton

quotes.quote: You can't connect the dots looking forward; you can only connect them looking backwards.
quotes.author: Steve Jobs

quotes.quote: Hard times create strong men. Strong men create good times. Good times create weak men. And weak men create hard times.
quotes.author: G. Michael Hopf

quotes.quote: The greatest victory is that which requires no battle.
quotes.author: Sun Tzu

quotes.quote: If you spend more on coffee than on IT security, you will be hacked. What's more, you deserve to be hacked.
quotes.author: Richard Clarke

quotes.quote: The only truly secure system is one that is powered off, cast in a block of concrete, and sealed in a lead-lined room with armed guards.
quotes.author: Gene Spafford

quotes.quote: Amateurs hack systems. Professionals hack people.
quotes.author: Bruce Schneier

quotes.quote: Tell me and I forget. Teach me and I remember. Involve me and I learn.
quotes.author: Benjamin Franklin

quotes.quote: A good leader takes a little more than his share of the blame, a little less than his share of the credit.
quotes.author: Arnold H. Glasgow

quotes.quote: Leadership is not about being in charge. It is about taking care of those in your charge.
quotes.author: Simon Sinek

quotes.quote: In the middle of difficulty lies opportunity.
quotes.author: Albert Einstein

quotes.quote: The warrior's approach is to say yes to life: yes to it all.
quotes.author: Joseph Campbell

quotes.quote: Adapt what is useful, reject what is useless, and add what is specifically your own.
quotes.author: Bruce Lee

quotes.quote: An organization's ability to learn, and translate that learning into action rapidly, is the ultimate competitive advantage.
quotes.author: Jack Welch

quotes.quote: The more you sweat in training, the less you bleed in battle.
quotes.author: Richard Marcinko

quotes.quote: Every system is perfectly designed to get the results it gets.
quotes.author: W. Edwards Deming

quotes.quote: The most dangerous leadership myth is that leaders are born. Leaders are made rather than born.
quotes.author: Warren Bennis

quotes.quote: Mentoring is a brain to pick, an ear to listen, and a push in the right direction.
quotes.author: John C. Crosby

quotes.quote: The day soldiers stop bringing you their problems is the day you have stopped leading them.
quotes.author: Colin Powell

quotes.quote: Tell me who your heroes are and I'll tell you how you'll turn out to be.
quotes.author: Warren Buffett

quotes.quote: A leader is best when people barely know he exists. When his work is done, his aim fulfilled, they will say: we did it ourselves.
quotes.author: Lao Tzu

quotes.quote: The truth of the matter is that you always know the right thing to do. The hard part is doing it.
quotes.author: Norman Schwarzkopf

quotes.quote: Out of every one hundred men, ten should not even be here, eighty are nothing but targets, nine are the real fighters, and we are lucky to have them, for they make the battle. Ah, but the one — one is a warrior, and he will bring the others back.
quotes.author: Attributed to Heraclitus (misattributed — origin: John DiFusco, Tracers, 1980)
quotes.source: Tracers (Off-Broadway play, 1980/1984) — commonly but incorrectly attributed to Heraclitus of Ephesus

quotes.quote: One man is ten thousand to me, if he is the best.
quotes.author: Heraclitus

quotes.quote: The secret of happiness is freedom, and the secret of freedom is courage.
quotes.author: Thucydides

quotes.quote: It is not that I am brave, but that I choose to be brave. And so the brave man is not the one who is unafraid, but the one who acts despite his fear.
quotes.author: Seneca

quotes.quote: Luck is what happens when preparation meets opportunity.
quotes.author: Seneca

quotes.quote: No man is free who is not master of himself.
quotes.author: Epictetus

quotes.quote: Make the best use of what is in your power, and take the rest as it happens.
quotes.author: Epictetus

quotes.quote: The impediment to action advances action. What stands in the way becomes the way.
quotes.author: Marcus Aurelius

quotes.quote: Experience is the teacher of all things.
quotes.author: Julius Caesar

quotes.quote: We do not imitate — we are a model to others.
quotes.author: Pericles
quotes.source: Funeral Oration, recorded in Thucydides, History of the Peloponnesian War, Book 2

quotes.quote: We are what we repeatedly do. Excellence, then, is not an act, but a habit.
quotes.author: Aristotle

quotes.quote: Seek freedom and become captive of your desires. Seek discipline and find your liberty.
quotes.author: Frank Herbert

quotes.quote: Rule your mind or it will rule you.
quotes.author: Horace

quotes.quote: We must all suffer one of two things: the pain of discipline or the pain of regret.
quotes.author: Jim Rohn
